title: Newsroom admin panel: notification settings for a site
description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** As a site admin, I see who subscribes, choose automatic sending or approval, approve held stories, send a test and read delivery history.

**Build.**
- Administration, panel label `Notifications`, `components/notifications-panel.tsx`, `lib/notifications-client.ts`, `?demo=1` fixture marked Sample, in the shape of `components/newsletter-panel.tsx`: reloads after actions, no realtime.
- Custom operations through a thin function; AppSync admits editor and admin, the function checks again. Accept and Reject vocabulary. Connections section appears for Slack and Discord when live: labelled placeholder until then, dimmed with a word.
- Addresses masked for editors. 'Account', never another word for the tenant.
- Screenshot review with Ryan.

**Acceptance.**
Ryan's screenshot approval; every action covered by a Gherkin scenario.

**Depends on:** PPY-44721a
**Related:** kanbus-c68e03, kanbus-b47fad

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Site notification settings
  Scenario: Choosing approval
    Given a site admin
    When they choose approval for new-story sends
    Then the next publish waits for an Accept

  Scenario: Send a test
    When an editor presses Send a test
    Then one message goes to their own address and shows in history

  Scenario: An editor reads history
    When an editor reads delivery history
    Then addresses are masked
```
